# `OutcomeUnavailable`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\OutcomeUnavailable`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/OutcomeUnavailable.php#L14) — **Version:** v0.5.0

**Extends:** `LogicException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

An invocation's outcome was read as the wrong kind: a returned value asked
of a call that threw. `null` is a valid return value, so this cannot be
signalled by returning null.
